_comment: REAL responses captured from a running Orion-LD 'post-v1.12.0' started with
-wip dds -mongocOnly, while the WISEPACK stack ran the mixed_pipes_small
scenario at seed 42. Values are abbreviated where noted with an ellipsis.
NOTE THE NESTING: every bridged value is at <attribute>.value.data, for
String and numeric types alike. Alongside 'value', Orion-LD also returns DDS
which consumers can ignore; they are omitted here for readability.
STATE-ORIENTED, not append-only. actionJson holds the LATEST action and
sequence the highest number reached. The append-only record is the
results/wisepack-actions-*.jsonl artefact. This repository does not claim

status._comment: Published on the ROS leaf `status_json`; the bare `status` leaf is reserved by Orion-LD's DDS module and never bridges. The FIWARE attribute name is unaffected.

_comment_approval: 'uninitialized' means the attribute is MAPPED but no DDS sample has been
propagated yet. It is not an error. Writing it drives the workflow — see

_comment: VERIFIED: returns HTTP 204 and moves the workflow from
WAIT_FOR_OPERATOR_APPROVAL to executing, via Orion-LD -> DDS -> ROS 2.
The nested value.data shape is REQUIRED. A plain {"value": "APPROVE"}
does NOT propagate to DDS and the orchestrator never sees it.
